items.evidence: requirements apiLevel 2.15 is valid; 1 µL and 5 µL mixes use p20, 50 µL and 40 µL mix use p300; the 61 µL final volume is well within the 200 µL wells; the simulator ran clean.
Each of the 8 DNA transfers and 8 SOC additions uses pick_up_tip and drop_tip, giving a fresh tip per well; the tip_before_aspirate, tip_dropped_at_end and no_cross_contamination checks all passed.
The protocol adds steps the paper does not describe: p20.mix(3,5) with blow_out after DNA addition, p300.mix(3,40) after SOC, and no lid heating, so it is not a fully faithful implementation.
tc.set_block_temperature(4) with the lid open, then 1 µL aspirated from plasmid well n and dispensed into transformation well n for A1–H1.
tc.close_lid(), then set_block_temperature(4, hold_time_minutes=30), then set_block_temperature(42, hold_time_seconds=30), then a return to 4 °C.
SOC_VOL=50 is dispensed into each cell well with p300 after the heat shock, then tc.close_lid() and set_block_temperature(37, hold_time_minutes=60).

judge.summary: The protocol follows the LV volumes and the 4 °C, 42 °C and 37 °C steps on the thermocycler, with fresh tips throughout, and all measured checks passed. It fails the all-or-nothing fidelity item because it adds mixing steps (and omits lid heating) that the paper does not describe.
